cutoff_rule: Last independently verified regular session of each month; filing date-only evidence is delayed until the following calendar day and a verified session

rolling.requires: representative PIT/execution/action gates passed, then stage-specific registration

budget_enforcement: Reserve attempts before calls; unknown usage is not zero; stop new calls when known usage reaches budget, subscription cap is not bypassed
A_prompt: Apply the V3 core principles supplied in the task; the original full Master Prompt V3 is not present and will not be invented

pit.restatement: Require original accession/publication version; current comparative statements not accepted as original past knowledge
pit.llm_historical_memory: Uncontrolled confound even in network-none worker

representative_gate: Dated candidate listing and original disclosures, official sessions, decision seal before evaluator, eligible prices and action/dividend coverage; fail closed if mandatory evidence missing
fallback: Run bounded PARTIAL source-grounded research and diagnostic plumbing if full replay blocked; never fabricate returns or treat cash caused by missing data as valid strategy performance

policy.costs: existing frozen task3 assumptions, empirical spreads unavailable flagged separately
policy.entry: Next verified regular session after all research input publication cutoffs

baseline_conditions: Index total-return if verified, otherwise explicit price-index limitation; same exposure index/cash; no invented sector-neutrality without historical sectors
